descriptionText:

Description
This is Volume 36 of the martial arts comedy manga 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy) by Tatsuya Egawa (蛭田達也), officially licensed and published in Taiwan by Tong Li Comics (東立出版社).
This vibrant volume showcases the main character’s rock ‘n’ roll spirit and comedic energy — combining classic martial arts themes with 90s-era visual flair. A fun, nostalgic collectible for vintage manga fans and readers of the Tong Li series.
